evidence.sourceTitle: Chime files registration statement for proposed IPO
evidence.shortExcerpt: Chime announced the S-1 filing, applied for Nasdaq listing as CHYM, and had not yet determined shares or price range.

observedFacts.statement: As of the 2025-05-13 announcement, Chime said the number of shares and price range had not yet been determined.
Chime announced on 2025-05-13 that it filed a Form S-1 for a proposed IPO.
Chime said it applied to list Class A common stock on Nasdaq under ticker CHYM.

evidence.shortExcerpt: The Form S-1 identifies Chime, reports Q1 2025 active members, 2024 operating metrics and partner-bank model limitations.

observedFacts.statement: Chime reported 8.0 million Active Members for 2024.
Chime reported a USD 25.3 million net loss for 2024.
Chime reported USD 34.540 billion of Purchase Volume for the three months ended 2025-03-31.
Chime reported 8.6 million Active Members as of 2025-03-31.
Chime reported that 67 percent of Active Members relied on Chime as a primary account relationship as of 2025-03-31.
Chime describes itself as a technology company, not a bank, with banking services provided by partner banks.
The S-1 identifies the registrant as Chime Financial, Inc., incorporated in Delaware, with CIK 0001795586.
